12/07/2026
Russell is a total handsome boy today!
We gave him the full package:
thorough brushing, express shedding treatment, and a SPA for his paws.
Now his coat is so soft and doesn’t shed, and his paws are like a baby’s 💅
Come get some beauty and care for your pup!
04/07/2026
Meet Bruno 👑
He has 3 rules:
1. I’m the most handsome
2. Ears must stand like wings
3. All other rules — are also me
After a Full Grooming at *Happy Pet*, Bruno went from a fluffy boy to a stylish gentleman.
Short body for the Sharm El Sheikh heat, round "Korean baby face", perfect ears.
Now he’s ready to conquer the streets and win hearts 💛
*Full Grooming at Happy Pet* = cleanliness + comfort + style.
Book via Direct 📩
30/06/2026
Meet Desi 💖
And this is your signature pink tail. You can't live without it 😉
We did a full package for Desi + a "summer baby face" style.
Sharma's shortest body is +40. Her head is round, her ears are erect, and her muzzle is open and happy.
And the icing on the cake: a pink tail. Now she's visible from afar!
*Full package at Happy Pet* = SPA + hygiene + haircut + styling + creative styling if desired.
To book, write to Direct 📩
